name: ROBOYORI
caption: A malfunctioning sex-robot wrestler built in MBE's own in-house lab, whose one documented match ended when his opponent tore his head clean off.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap of "The New Neighbors Have a Hot Tub" (20 July 2007), served

name: Petey Esdee
caption: A dishonorably discharged Army veteran turned MBE wrestler, billed as PTSD, whose matches are staged as flashbacks to his own combat tours.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first three fwrestling.com shows (20 July, 7 August, 22 August 2007), served

name: General Mayhem
caption: A cashiered British Army general turned MBE heel, lecturing every opponent on discipline before beating them with it.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first three fwrestling.com shows (20 July, 7 August, 22 August 2007), served

identity.note: A bare-name collision with a held military-general gimmick at a different federation (aka Roger Tonner). No document read this pass connects the two, and a cashiered-officer wrestling gimmick is common enough on its own; filed distinct rather than merged.

name: Jeffrey Roberts
caption: MBE's own returning psychopath, a self-described former inmate who carves messages into his opponents between matches.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first three fwrestling.com shows and the fed's own promo exchanges for the Lord of the Boards tournament, served; billed for the Lord of the Boards final on the third show's own recap

name: Justin Evitable
caption: MBE's self-styled "True Face," a perpetual world-title contender who has never quite closed the deal.

tenures.source: MBE's own press conference of 2 July 2007, its Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first three fwrestling.com shows, and its own promo exchanges, all served

name: Johnny Onan
caption: A former male model turned MBE wrestler, billed as the Ultimate Adonis, whose finishing headlock is matched only by his own vanity.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first three fwrestling.com shows, served; billed for the Lord of the Boards final on the third show's own recap

name: Jeff Hawkins
caption: A Texas-trained rookie billed as MBE's Wild Card, wrestling under a deck-of-cards gimmick out of his adoptive father's own wrestling ranch.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its second and third fwrestling.com shows (7 August and 22 August 2007), served

name: Duke Mason
caption: A washed-up rock musician turned MBE wrestler, whose finishing move doubles as a guitar solo.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap of "Singled Out" (7 August 2007), served

name: El Vega
caption: A Mexican mariachi performer turned MBE wrestler, entering every appearance with his own band in tow.

tenures.source: MBE's own roster profile thread (posted 5 July 2007), served; no match by this wrestler survives in the held record

name: Mac Forrest
caption: One-third of the Sheffield Wednesday Lot, an MBE hooligan trio devoted to their English football club above all else.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first and third fwrestling.com shows (20 July and 22 August 2007), served

name: Nate MacNally
caption: A member of the Sheffield Wednesday Lot left with a stated concussion partway through MBE's 2007 relaunch.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap of "The New Neighbors Have a Hot Tub" (20 July 2007), served

name: Juen Lee
caption: The third member of the Sheffield Wednesday Lot, billed as an aspiring Olympic luger between shows.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap of "The New Neighbors Have a Hot Tub" (20 July 2007), served

name: Hoss Garrison
caption: Half of MBE's Thrillbillies tag team, a South Carolina brawler who wrestles the way he talks.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recaps of its first three fwrestling.com shows (20 July, 7 August, 22 August 2007), served

name: Jake McCody
caption: The high-flying half of MBE's Thrillbillies tag team, a South Carolina daredevil who has never met a dive he wouldn't attempt.

tenures.source: MBE's own Wrestling Chronicle recap of "The New Neighbors Have a Hot Tub" (20 July 2007), served; sidelined by injury on the later shows per the same fed's own reporting
